label: managerial or leadership office in
definition: The first person holds or held an explicit managerial or leadership office in the second organization or governing body.
scope_notes: The head/chair/executive/chief family collectively dominates and matches the earlier broad managerial-office scope. Include explicit executive, chair, president, director or equivalent office without requiring sole overall control. Analyst, founder, owner, ordinary employment and a nomination alone are excluded.
